STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast/brunch plate photographed from above (near top-down). It holds scrambled eggs, breakfast potatoes, pineapple chunks, a sausage link, strawberries, and a mixed salad of spinach and greens.

STEP 2 - Ruler: A rectangular white plate roughly 26 cm across its long side. Treating it as a dinner plate, area ≈ 3.14 × (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2. The food fills roughly 75% of it, mostly in the lower-left and right-center.

STEP 3 - Items: scrambled eggs, breakfast potato cubes, pineapple chunks, pork sausage link, strawberry halves, mixed greens/spinach with a light dressing.

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, sums to ~75%):
- Mixed greens/spinach: 22% = 117 cm^2 x 3 cm = 350 ml x 0.15 = 53 g x 20 kcal/100g = 11 kcal
- Breakfast potatoes: 15% = 80 cm^2 x 2 cm = 160 ml x 0.8 = 128 g x 130 kcal/100g = 166 kcal (roasted, oil-cooked; use ~150 kcal/100g = 192 kcal)
- Scrambled eggs: 12% = 64 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 96 ml x 0.9 = 86 g x 150 kcal/100g = 129 kcal
- Pineapple chunks: 10% = 53 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 80 ml x 0.6 = 48 g x 50 kcal/100g = 24 kcal
- Pork sausage link: 8% = 42 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 64 ml x 0.95 = 61 g x 300 kcal/100g = 183 kcal (sausage link ~1.5 cm tall)
- Strawberries: 4% = 21 cm^2 x 1 cm = 21 ml x 0.6 = 13 g x 32 kcal/100g = 4 kcal
- Light dressing: ~5 g x 60 kcal/100g = 3 kcal

Totals: about 178 g of food on the lower-density items plus the dense ones, roughly 370 g combined, around 550 kcal.

STEP 5-7 summary: Greens ~53 g, potatoes ~128 g, eggs ~86 g, pineapple ~48 g, sausage ~61 g, strawberries ~13 g, dressing ~5 g. Total ≈ 394 g.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A fairly full brunch plate of about 400 g and roughly 550 kcal is plausible for what is visible.
